title: Security Engineer
description:
Il Gruppo EIES, composto da Energent, I&M, Enway e Skienda è una realtà di consulenza e di prodotto consolidata nel mercato delle soluzioni e dei servizi ICT.

Ricerchiamo un Security Engineer con esperienza di livello intermedio e autonomia operativa, da inserire all'interno del team IT di una importante azienda del settore trasporti e logistica.

La figura sarà protagonista nella definizione e nell’avvio di nuovi progetti di sicurezza e avrà il compito di valutare l’impatto e i requisiti di sicurezza anche in tutte le iniziative progettuali.




Attività principali nelle quali sarai coinvolto:

 * Gestire i progetti di nuove soluzioni di sicurezza, contribuendo attivamente alla loro implementazione (protezione dati, accessi, reti, applicazioni).
 * Valutare la postura di sicurezza di nuovi progetti interni, anche se proposti da altre unità organizzative.
 * Ricevere, comprendere e analizzare report di vulnerability assessment (inclusi da fornitori terzi o strumenti interni).
 * Definire piani di remediation coerenti con il rischio effettivo associato a ciascuna vulnerabilità (risk-based prioritization).
 * Analizzare, applicare e ottimizzare le matrici di approvabilità dei flussi di rete, garantendo che le comunicazioni
 * tra sistemi e applicazioni siano conformi alle policy di sicurezza e alle best practice di segmentazione.
 * Collaborare con team tecnici e di progetto per integrare la sicurezza sin dalla fase di design (security by design).
 * Fornire linee guida architetturali in ambito sicurezza per infrastrutture on-premise e cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
 * Redigere documentazione tecnica e supportare processi di governance e compliance (es. ISO 27001, GDPR).
 * Monitorare trend di minacce e tecnologie emergenti per garantire la resilienza continua delle soluzioni adottate.




Must Have




Esperienza:

 * 3–5 anni di esperienza in ambito sicurezza IT, architetture o soluzioni di security.
 * Esperienza in ambienti complessi (preferibilmente logistica, trasporti, industria, servizi).

Competenze tecniche necessarie:

 * Architetture di rete sicure, segmentazione, firewalling, IAM.
 * Definizione e gestione di progetti di integrazione di sistemi di sicurezza
 * Sicurezza in ambienti cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
 * Conoscenza di strumenti SIEM, EDR, DLP, vulnerability management.
 * Conoscenza consolidata di sistemi operativi Linux e Microsoft.
 * Familiarità con i concetti di Risk Management.
 * Familiarità con normative e standard (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).

Soft Skill:

 * Autonomia operativa e capacità decisionale.
 * Ottime capacità analitiche e comunicative.
 * Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari e di interfacciarsi con stakeholder non tecnici.
 * Inglese buono (scritto e parlato).




Nice to have




 * Laurea in discipline tecniche o STEM o esperienza equivalente.
 * Certificazioni con focus sicurezza, CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty

Cosa offriamo:

 * Ambiente di lavoro dinamico ed orientato alla crescita professionale;
 * Certification Program: il programma formativo di EIES Group pensato per supportare e valorizzare la crescita professionale in un’ottica di miglioramento continuo;
 * Birthday Off: un giorno di riposo extra per staccare dal lavoro e festeggiare il tuo compleanno come meriti!
 * Buoni pasto;
 * Piattaforma di e-commerce con scontistiche riservate ai dipendenti e altre convenzioni dedicate;
 * Confronto all'interno di un team strutturato e coeso;
 * Inquadramento contrattuale e retributivo commisurato alla Seniority;
 * Programma di Buddy: un collega dedicato che ti affiancherà nel periodo iniziale per facilitare l'integrazione nel team e supportarti nell'apprendimento dei processi aziendali;·
 * Welfare aziendale.




Sede di lavoro: Basiano (MI)

Modalità di lavoro: ibrida




Chi siamo?

Il Gruppo EIES rappresenta l'alleanza strategica di quattro aziende italiane leader nel settore informatico, unite per offrire al mercato una copertura completa, integrata e sinergica.

Composto da Energent, I&M Consulting, Enway e Skienda, il Gruppo è una realtà che eroga consulenza, progettualità e servizi in ambito ICT, fornendo soluzioni ad alto valore aggiunto per i propri clienti. Con sedi a Roma, Napoli e Milano, operiamo in settori come Finance, Insurance, Telco, Energy e Pubblica Amministrazione, collaborando con aziende di primaria importanza ed i principali System Integrator.

Il gruppo è organizzato in practices tematiche afferenti a diverse aree di competenza: Infrastrutture & Security, Application Modernization & Cloud Transformation, Data Science e Artificial Intelligence e Consulting. Inoltre, il Gruppo dispone di due Factory specializzate in Sviluppo Software e Dati che lavorano sinergicamente per progettare soluzioni innovative, affidabili e personalizzate e per la delivery di progetti chiavi in mano.

Unirsi al Gruppo EIES significa entrare a far parte di una realtà dinamica e all'avanguardia, dove il contributo di ciascuno viene valorizzato e l'innovazione è al centro di ciò che facciamo. Se cerchi una sfida stimolante in un ambiente in continua evoluzione, il nostro gruppo è il posto giusto per te.

Il presente annuncio è rivolto a entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77.

title: Senior Penetration Tester
description:
CHI SIAMO

Tinexta Cyber è il polo italiano della Cyber Security, che unisce l'eccellenza nella protezione digitale ad un approccio innovativo alla system integration. Siamo un punto di riferimento per le aziende che cercano soluzioni avanzate e sicure, grazie alle nostre tecnologie proprietarie e competenze all’avanguardia. La nostra missione è creare ambienti digitali robusti, performanti e modulari, dove sicurezza e tecnologia si uniscono per garantire un futuro digitale sicuro e senza compromessi.




Tinexta Cyber fa parte di Tinexta SpA, Gruppo industriale quotato in Borsa Italiana (segmento Euronext STAR Milan) con HQ in Italia, oltre 3.000 dipendenti nel mondo e attivo in tre settori strategici: Digital Trust, Cyber Security e Business Innovation. Attraverso le società del Gruppo, promuove un’offerta integrata di servizi avanzati per l’identità e la certificazione digitale, cyber security, digital marketing e accesso ai finanziamenti per l’innovazione e l’internazionalizzazione.







IL TUO RUOLO

Stiamo cercando una figura di Senior Penetration Tester da inserire nel team Offensive Security. La risorsa sarà coinvolta in progetti di penetration testing al fine di fornire delle valutazioni di sicurezza su software, infrastrutture e hardware.




Principali responsabilità:

 * Attività di Vulnerability Assessment e Penetration Testing con l'ausilio di strumenti automatici, ma anche attraverso attività manuali di discovery e test delle vulnerabilità
 * Analisi di sicurezza delle infrastrutture (es. protocolli, apparati)
 * Gestione del processo di Vulnerability Management sulle applicazioni e reporting
 * Redazione di documentazione tecnica (walkthrough, assessment, solution design, presentazioni)




Cosa cerchiamo:

 * Esperienza di 4/5 anni anni in ruolo analogo
 * Laurea, o titolo di studio equivalente, in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Elettronica, delle Telecomunicazioni o inerenti all’ambito della CyberSecurity
 * Partecipazione a progetti nell’individuazione e valutazione di vulnerabilità, sia attraverso attività manuali che automatiche
 * Esperienze di mobile security su sistemi operativi Android/iOS
 * Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (livello B2)
 * Capacità di ascolto e acquisizione delle esigenze del cliente
 * Capacità di lavorare per obiettivi e in autonomia
 * Interesse ad evolvere la propria conoscenza verso soluzioni di sicurezza innovative
 * Costituisce titolo preferenziale il possesso di certificazioni quali OSCP, OPST, CEH o equivalenti




Cosa devi conoscere:

 * Networking: TCP/IP routing, switching, protocolli di rete e tool per l'analisi dei pacchetti
 * Metodologie: Vulnerability Assessment e ottime capacità di Penetration Testing, con particolare riferimento ad OWASP (web e mobile)
 * Sistemi Operativi: Windows, Linux, Unix
 * Linguaggi di programmazione/scripting: C, C++, C#, Java, PowerShell, PHP, Python, Ruby o Bash
 * Conoscenza di Active Directory, Foreste, Group Policy e, più in generale, tutto ciò che concerne questi ambiti tipici dell'ecosistema Windows, in termini di discovery e analisi finalizzate al Vulnerability Assessment e al Penetration Test
 * Conoscenza dei processi per il Vulnerability Management
 * Autonomia nella redazione di report tecnici
 * Familiarità con strumenti quali Metasploit, ma più in generale capacità di scripting avanzato per elaborare procedure di exploit customizzate




Sedi di lavoro: Milano o Cesena







Think next, secure now

In Tinexta Cyber crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Per questo, ci impegniamo a garantire la parità di genere e un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, in cui ogni singola risorsa possa contribuire con un valore unico al nostro Gruppo. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel Regolamento UE 2016/679.

title: Senior OT Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Relatech Spa è un'azienda italiana nata nel 2001 con una missione chiara: guidare l'Innovazione e la Trasformazione Digitale. 🚀

Oggi, con un team di 800 talenti e una rete di 14 sedi, sia nazionali che internazionali, siamo molto più di una realtà tecnologica: siamo il motore del Rinascimento Digitale. 💡

Grazie a competenze consolidate in ambiti come Cloud☁️, Cybersecurity🛡️, Machine Learning🤖, AR/VR🕶️, Blockchain🔗, IoT🌐 e Automazione industriale⚙️, siamo partner strategici per accompagnare le aziende verso il futuro, creando soluzioni end-to-end che generano valore reale e tangibile.

Il nostro Rinascimento Digitale 🌟

Per noi, il Rinascimento Digitale è molto più di un semplice approccio tecnologico: è la nostra filosofia🌱

È il driver che ci spinge a democratizzare la tecnologia, rendendola accessibile, inclusiva e al servizio delle persone.

Unendo il Rinascimento Digitale al concetto di Nuovo Umanesimo Digitale, puntiamo a mettere la tecnologia al centro del miglioramento della vita delle persone e delle organizzazioni ✨

Per ampliamento organico della BU Cyber, IT & Cloud di Relatech, per la nostra sede di Genova, ricerchiamo una risorsa per ricoprire il ruolo di

Senior OT Cybersecurity Specialist

La figura ricercata sarà inserita nel team di Cybersecurity OT esistente dedicato alla sicurezza delle reti degli impianti industriali. Il candidato ideale ha maturato esperienza nelle pratiche di sicurezza sia in ambito IT che OT, e possiede una buona conoscenza dei principali sistemi di controllo di processo e dei protocolli industriali.

Il ruolo prevede la responsabilità della protezione dei sistemi industriali e delle reti OT dei clienti, con l’obiettivo di garantire operazioni affidabili, sicure ed efficienti.

Il team si occupa non solo della parte di advisory legata alle normative ma anche di tutte le fasi operative tecniche: dalla raccolta delle informazioni sullo stato attuale delle infrastrutture, alla determinazione del livello di rischio di un impianto di produzione, alla messa in sicurezza e riprogettazione delle intere infrastrutture OT dei clienti.

La risorsa ricercata è una figura senior che dovrà inoltre essere in grado di eseguire attività come:

Leadership e gestione


 * Guida del gruppo: guidare e gestire un gruppo di professionisti della cybersecurity OT, fornendo direzione e supporto.
 * Sviluppo di strategie: sviluppare strategie di sicurezza OT a livello aziendale, allineate con gli obiettivi dell'organizzazione.
 * Gestione dei budget: gestire i budget per le attività di cybersecurity OT e assicurare l'allocazione efficiente delle risorse.
   
   
   

Sviluppo di politiche e procedure per i nostri clienti


 * Sviluppo di politiche di sicurezza: sviluppare e implementare politiche di sicurezza OT a livello aziendale.
 * Procedure di risposta agli incidenti: sviluppare e testare procedure di risposta agli incidenti di sicurezza OT in collaborazione con il nostro SOC.
 * Sviluppo di standard di sicurezza: sviluppare e implementare standard di sicurezza OT per l'organizzazione.
   
   
   

Valutazione del rischio e mitigazione


 * Valutazione del rischio OT: condurre valutazione del rischio OT a livello aziendale e identificare aree di miglioramento.
 * Sviluppo di "Remediation Plans": sviluppare piani di mitigazione per ridurre i rischi di sicurezza OT.
 * Implementazione di controlli di sicurezza: implementare controlli di sicurezza OT per proteggere i sistemi e le infrastrutture critiche.
   
   
   

Innovazione e miglioramento continuo


 * Ricerca e sviluppo: condurre ricerche e sviluppare nuove soluzioni per migliorare la sicurezza OT.
 * Miglioramento continuo: identificare aree di miglioramento e contribuire ad implementare processi di adozione di nuove soluzioni OT dell'organizzazione verso i nostri clienti.
   
   
   

CHI CERCHIAMO?

Titolo di studio


 * Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, Cybersecurity o campi correlati. Master Cybersecurity su infrastrutture critiche (preferenziale)
   
   
   

Competenze Tecniche:


 * Conoscenza approfondita dei protocolli industriali, in particolare: Modbus, UMAS, S7 200-300-400, EtherNet/IP, CIP, OPC UA, OPC (DA/HDA/AE), BACnet/IP, PROFINET, SOFBUS/LACBUS, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850 (MMS, Goose & SV), S7+.
 * Competenza degli standard di sicurezza delle informazioni, dei framework, della valutazione del rischio e delle migliori pratiche da ISA99, IEC62443, NIST 800-82.
 * Solida comprensione della rete OT, inclusa la conoscenza di switch, router e firewall industriali.
 * Capacità di lettura e comprensione di schemi elettrici e funzionali.
 * Forti capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi per la risoluzione dei problemi e l'ottimizzazione dei sistemi OT.
 * Esperienza nell’installazione, configurazione e gestione di soluzioni di monitoraggio passivo delle infrastrutture OT.
 * Familiarità con strumenti SIEM e sistemi di allarme OT/ICS, con capacità di analisi e risposta agli eventi di sicurezza.
 * Conoscenza dei principali sistemi di controllo industriale (DCS, SCADA, PLC) e delle relative vulnerabilità.
 * Capacità di lavorare in ambienti critici e ad alta disponibilità, garantendo la sicurezza senza impattare la continuità operativa.
 * Competenze base di scripting (es. Python, Bash) per l’automazione e l’analisi dei dati.
 * Comprensione dei concetti di segmentazione di rete, DMZ industriali e zone/conduits secondo IEC 62443.
 * Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica e report di sicurezza chiari e strutturati.
   
   
   

Abilità Didattiche:


 * Adattabilità nella personalizzazione dei contenuti formativi rispetto ai diversi target aziendali.
 * Capacità di trasferire conoscenze tecniche complesse a interlocutori non specialisti (es. operatori di impianto, manutentori).
 * Attitudine alla formazione interna, con la possibilità di condurre sessioni tecniche su pratiche di sicurezza OT.
 * Chiarezza espositiva nel presentare analisi di rischio, risultati di assessment e piani di remediation.
 * Abilità nell’elaborare documentazione formativa (guide, manuali operativi, best practice) per utenti OT.
 * Propensione al mentoring e al supporto tecnico per colleghi junior o di altri dipartimenti
   
   
   

Qualità Personali:


 * Empatia: Sensibilità verso le esigenze degli utenti, con capacità di supporto e incoraggiamento.
 * Pensiero Laterale: Attitudine al problem solving creativo e al critical thinking.
 * Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio, fondamentali per operare in ambienti critici e sensibili.
 * Spirito di iniziativa e capacità di lavorare in autonomia, mantenendo elevati standard di sicurezza.
 * Flessibilità e capacità di adattarsi a contesti operativi diversi, anche in ambienti industriali complessi.
   
   
   

COSA OFFRIAMO?


 * Contratto a tempo indeterminato e RAL commisurata all'esperienza
 * Ambiente dinamico e collaborativo.
 * Opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi e tecnologie di ultima generazione.
 * Percorsi di crescita e possibilità di certificazioni in ambito Cyber Security.

🏡 pattern di lavoro: ibrido con disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all’estero.

title: 2026 Grad Program, Cyber Security
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.

This is an exclusive opportunity for top students on track to graduate between December 2025 and December 2026 to learn, make an impact, and accelerate their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
 * Run security audits, identifying security loopholes and opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of security strategies.
 * Perform internal vulnerability testing, uncovering any weaknesses in the systems and implementing countermeasures to ensure the integrity of all data.
 * Identify company-wide security challenges. Design and implement solutions to strengthen protection and streamline security practices across IT and infrastructure areas.
 * Collaborate closely with privacy experts to ensure the most robust and complete privacy compliance strategy possible, and to translate regulations into tech implementations.
 * Stay up to date with security trends and threats. Share knowledge with Spooners to ensure data protection best practices and help foster a security-focused culture across the company.
   
   

What we look for
 * Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
 * Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
 * Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
 * Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
   
   

What we offer
 * Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
 * An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
 * Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer an individual at the start of their career a salary of £66,779 in the UK and €63,965 elsewhere. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £110,389 and £149,636 in the UK, and €105,737 and €143,330 elsewhere. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience and translate it into greater impact. You can also receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
 * All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
   
   

Commitment & contract
Fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK) or remote.

The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll ask you to take on a few tests designed to assess how you approach unfamiliar problems. They’re challenging and may take several hours to complete. If you’re successful with those, we’ll invite you to a series of interviews.

We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment any applicant and provide reasonable accommodations for an individual with disabilities—just let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Professional Security Governance
description:
La divisione Public Sector di Randstad Leaders Search&Selection, specializzata nella ricerca e selezione di middle e senior management, ricerca per il Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato




Professional Security Governance




La figura, inserita nel team di Security Governance a Roma, si occuperà di garantire la conformità a standard e normative di sicurezza logica e fisica. Le sue principali responsabilità includeranno:

 * Gestione della Compliance: Condurre audit e assessment per assicurare il rispetto degli standard internazionali;
 * Sistemi di Gestione: Mantenere le certificazioni ISO 27001 e ISO 22301;
 * Gestione del Rischio: Analizzare e mitigare i rischi, definendo KPI/KRI;
 * Procedure e Formazione: Creare policy e procedure interne e condurre programmi di security awareness.




Requisiti obbligatori

 * Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni, Ingegneria Elettronica, Sicurezza Informatica, Cybersecurity. In alternativa alle lauree indicate sopra, si richiede la laurea Specialistica/Magistrale e il possesso di almeno 1 delle seguenti qualifiche/certificazioni: CISA, CISM, CISSP o Lead Auditor ISO 22301.
 * Certificazione Lead Auditor ISO/IEC 27001:2022
 * Almeno 4 anni in un ruolo simile, in realtà industriali o di consulenza. È richiesta una solida esperienza in almeno due aree, tra cui implementazione di Sistemi di Gestione della Sicurezza e gestione dei rischi.
 * Ottima conoscenza di almeno due tra: Principi di Auditing, Standard di sicurezza e Project Management. Richiesta la conoscenza di base di sicurezza IT e crittografia, oltre all'inglese.




Per ulteriori dettagli si rimanda a quanto pubblicato nell'avviso.




La figura ricercata verrà inserita presso la sede di Roma, con un inquadramento fino al gruppo “A” ai sensi del vigente CCNL per le Aziende Grafiche e Affini e delle Aziende Editoriali anche Multimediali.

Il livello di inquadramento e la retribuzione saranno commisurati alla seniority.




Le candidature dovranno pervenire tramite il link:

https://selezione.pa.randstad.it/professionalsecuritygovernanceipzs

Il termine per l'invio delle candidature è entro le ore 11.59 del giorno 08 ottobre 2025.

title: IPWAY ASSUME: Cybersecurity Managed Services Specialist, MDR & Threat Hunting (Vicenza) - Ottima RAL + welfare + certificazioni
description:
L’OPPORTUNITÀ IN SINTESI

AZIENDA: Ipway

SETTORE: Security & Network Managed Services, IT System Integration

RUOLO: Cybersecurity Specialist, MDR & Threat Hunting

TEAM: Managed Services

INGAGGIO: Assunzione immediata a tempo indeterminato

RETRIBUZIONE: Ottimo livello (fisso + variabile + welfare + percorso certificazioni tecniche)

SEDE: Vicenza città

COMPETENZE/REQUISITI INDISPENSABILI: MDR, Cybersecurity, inglese fluente, reperibilità, domicilio in zona




L’AZIENDA

 * IPway nasce a Vicenza nel 2012 ed è un System Integrator e Network & Security Managed Service Provider (MSSP) che eroga, come servizio gestito, soluzioni di rete e sicurezza di vendor leader scelti con profonda competenza tecnica
 * Attività: 100% networking e cybersecurity. La focalizzazione consente di offrire un supporto tecnico di livello, soluzioni consulenziali ed elevata efficacia operativa
 * Portafoglio di offerta: servizi di co-gestione che mitigano la mancanza di personale specialistico delle aziende clienti, semplificandone l'ambiente tecnologico e garantendo il controllo di informazioni, ambiente di rete e sicurezza
 * Clienti: aziende midmarket/enterprise (500-3000 posti di lavoro, nazionali e internazionali, più sedi), caratterizzate da requisiti di sicurezza avanzati e ambienti di rete complessi, che necessitino di un partner solido e competente che, in logica di servizio, li affianchi nella gestione del quotidiano e nell’evoluzione della postura di sicurezza
 * Valori: rapidità, competenza, certificazioni, disponibilità, approccio consulenziale
 * Numeri: fatturato previsto 2025 €3.3M (in forte crescita e in utile), 15 persone




IL RUOLO

 * All’interno di un programma di espansione, Ipway cerca un Cybersecurity Managed Services Specialist che si occupi proattivamente di Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Threat Hunting, rilevazione/risposta a minacce e miglioramento continuo della sicurezza delle aziende clienti
 * Il candidato ideale parla un buon inglese, ha un percorso di studi tecnico (idealmente laurea in Ingegneria, Telecomunicazioni o Informatica) e una solida esperienza cybersecurity, conosce strumenti e framework di settore ed è pronto a incontri periodici con i clienti per condividere analisi e proposte di azioni migliorative




PERCHÉ NON PERDERE QUESTA OPPORTUNITÀ

 * Per operare in un ruolo centrale in un’azienda di valore, giovane, innovativa, solida e in forte crescita
 * Per incrementare continuativamente le proprie competenze tecniche e acquisire importanti certificazioni
 * Per emergere e realizzarsi professionalmente ed economicamente, partecipando attivamente al percorso di crescita aziendale
 * Per imparare sempre qualcosa di nuovo, confrontandosi con varie realtà e toccando con mano il risultato del proprio lavoro




SEDE DI LAVORO

Vicenza città (vicinanze A4 Vicenza ovest)




TEAM

La figura entrerà nel team Managed Services riportando al Managed Services Manager




PRINCIPALI COMPITI E RESPONSABILITA’

 * Conoscenza portafoglio prodotti e servizi, acquisizione di certificazioni tecniche
 * Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Threat Hunting, rilevazione proattiva di minacce
 * Analisi avanzata di sicurezza con strumenti di top vendor (Darktrace, SentinelOne, Cato Networks, Netskope, Fortinet, Armis …)
 * Gestione e configurazione dispositivi di sicurezza (EDR, NDR, XDR, Firewall, IDS, IPS …)
 * Gestione/analisi ticket di sicurezza, risoluzione incidenti utilizzando framework (NIST, MITRE ATT&CK) per classificazione e gestione delle minacce
 * Monitoraggio e gestione aggiornamenti di sicurezza: CVE (Common Vulnerabilities & Exposures), CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System)
 * Produzione analisi di cybersecurity; Partecipazione a incontri tecnici con i clienti per presentare risultati, miglioramenti e raccomandazioni
 * Contributo attivo al miglioramento continuo della postura di sicurezza dei clienti (playbook, runbook, strategie difensive)
 * Responsabilità e gestione delle problematiche del cliente (e delle relative opportunità) per quanto riguarda la propria area di attività




COMPETENZE, REQUISITI, ESPERIENZE

 * Domicilio (o disponibilità a trasferirsi) in zona
 * Percorso di studi tecnico, idealmente con laurea in Ingegneria, Telecomunicazioni o Informatica (o competenze equivalenti)
 * Conoscenza fluente della lingua Inglese per interagire con clienti internazionali
 * Disponibilità alla reperibilità da remoto (con turni)
 * Alcune delle seguenti competenze elencate in ordine di importanza decrescente (la presenza di certificazioni costituirà un plus):
 * Soluzioni cybersecurity: NDR, Endpoint protection, SASE, SSE, Next-Generation Firewall
 * Vendor cybersecurity: Darktrace, SentinelOne, Cato Networks, Netskope, Fortinet, Armis (o comparabili)
 * Attività cybersecurity: MDR, Threat Hunting, Blue Team, Security Operation Center (SOC)
 * Security framework (NIST, MITRE ATT&CK)
 * Attacchi OWASP (XSS, SQL Injection)
 * Principi di Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Authentication, Non-Repudiation
 * Fasi di attacchi informatici (reconnaissance, weaponization, delivery, exploitation, installation, command & control, actions on objectives)
 * Stack ISO/OSI, protocolli di rete (SMB, FTP, SSH, DHCP, DNS)
 * Configurazione e gestione subnetting (IP, subnet mask, gateway)
 * Certificazioni CEH, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, OSCP
 * Sistemi di ticketing
 * Crittografia simmetrica e asimmetrica
 * Active Directory




CARATTERISTICHE VINCENTI

 * Questo è un ruolo 100% Cybersecurity Managed Services che richiede ottime basi tecniche e passione per il proprio lavoro e tutto ciò che afferisce alla Cybersecurity
 * Desiderio di mettersi in gioco, specializzarsi e accrescere competenze e capacità; Attitudine all’apprendimento e al miglioramento costante
 * Approccio orientato al risultato, capacità di lavorare in modo organizzato e per obiettivi, praticità, accuratezza, metodicità, puntualità, attenzione al dettaglio
 * Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e prendere l'iniziativa
 * Capacità di offrire al cliente un servizio di valore generando una relazione duratura
 * Attitudine al lavoro in team, consapevolezza di lavorare per un obiettivo comune considerando la visione d’insieme aziendale e la soddisfazione del cliente come priorità
 * Capacità relazionali: approccio positivo, comunicazione efficace, pensiero critico, ascolto attivo
 * Ambizione alla crescita personale e professionale
 * Etica, riservatezza




L’AZIENDA OFFRE

 1. Inserimento in un ruolo centrale in un’azienda di valore, giovane, innovativa, solida e in forte crescita
 2. Assunzione immediata a tempo indeterminato (full-time)
 3. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) di ottimo livello (fisso + variabile + welfare + percorso strutturato di certificazione tecnica) correlata alle competenze del candiato
 4. Formazione continua con acquisizione di certificazioni e forte possibilità di crescita professionale




PER CANDIDARSI

 * LA RICERCA E SELEZIONE È CONDOTTA SENZA INTERMEDIAZIONE, DIRETTAMENTE ED ESCLUSIVAMENTE DALL’AZIENDA (con il supporto di PBS per digital e comunicazione)
 * Si invita a candidarsi tramite LinkedIn verificando di aver caricato in LinkedIn il CV (PDF) più AGGIORNATO
 * Tutte le candidature verranno attentamente valutate. I candidati più interessanti verranno contattati entro 24 ore

title: Embedded Security Specialist
description:
About us

At Exein, our mission is to build the world’s first ecosystem for IoT device security, ensuring all types of devices are secure globally. Our dynamic team is passionate about data, machine learning, open source, and firmware. We constantly work to secure millions of devices, making daily life safer for everyone. Our unique products empower developers to secure their IoT devices with cutting-edge technology in an easy and frictionless way.



Responsibilities:

 * Design and implement security agents tailored specifically for real-time operating systems (RTOS) on microcontrollers, monitoring internals such as memory management, task scheduling, interrupt handling, and state transitions.
 * Perform detailed research into innovative methods for introspection and security monitoring within constrained microcontroller environments.
 * Prototype, evaluate, and refine embedded security technologies targeted for RTOS-based devices.
 * Contribute actively to Exein’s open-source initiatives, sharing discoveries and enhancements beneficial to the broader embedded community.
 * Ensure high-quality software development through meticulous code reviews, rigorous testing, and comprehensive documentation.



Requirements:

 * Deep expertise with internals of real-time microcontroller operating systems (e.g., FreeRTOS, ESP32-IDF, Zephyr).
 * Strong proficiency in low-level programming languages, specifically C, C++, or Rust.
 * Solid understanding of embedded cybersecurity practices, including secure boot, memory protection mechanisms, and runtime monitoring strategies.
 * Demonstrated experience in debugging and analyzing embedded firmware and system-level issues.
 * Familiarity with Git-based collaborative workflows and CI/CD practices for embedded software development.



Preferred:

 * Experience utilizing introspection and tracing tools specifically designed for RTOS and microcontroller environments.
 * Knowledge of IoT cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and anomaly detection methodologies relevant to embedded systems.
 * Practical experience with scripting languages like Python for automation, testing, and analysis within embedded contexts.



Why Join Us?

 * We’re a mission-led team solving tough, meaningful problems.
 * You’ll have autonomy and impact from Day 1.
 * We’re growing fast—which means so will your opportunities.



Location

Rome (Piazzale Flaminio 19, 00196) – Hybrid mode

title: Operational Technology (OT) Security Expert
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of sustainable industries?

Join GEA and become part of a global team that’s driving innovation, excellence, and impact across the food, beverage, and process sectors.

Responsibilities / Tasks

The OT Security Expert identifies and translates legal and customer-specific OT security requirements into robust, audit-compliant policies, processes, and guidelines across GEA’s production environments—including IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things), ICS (Industrial Control Systems), and SCADA systems.

They are responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously enhancing the security posture of Operational Technology, ensuring protection across production processes, automation systems, network infrastructure, and IIoT platforms.

How You'll Make An Impact


 * OT Security Implementation: Define and apply security measures for industrial environments, aligned with company policies and standards such as IEC 62443.Risk Assessment & Vulnerability Analysis: Conduct evaluations of OT systems to identify threats and recommend mitigation strategies.
 * Monitoring & Incident Response: Oversee OT networks and systems to detect anomalies and manage security incidents.
 * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with IT, engineering, and operations teams to integrate security into industrial processes.
 * Project & Vendor Management: Lead OT cybersecurity initiatives, including coordination with external suppliers.
 * Training & Awareness: Promote OT security culture through internal training and awareness programs.
   
   

Your Profile / Qualifications

What sets you up for success:


 * Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
 * Strong experience in IT/OT Security, specifically in ICS, IIoT, and SCADA environments.
 * Solid experience in industrial, OT, or manufacturing settings, or in IT service delivery, operations, or architecture.
 * In-depth knowledge of ICS, IIoT, SCADA, and automation systems (DCS, PLC, etc.).
 * Hands-on experience with industrial security standards (e.g., IEC 62443)
 * Proficiency in firewall technologies, vulnerability management, patching, and encryption.
 * Familiarity with network protocols (TCP, UDP, IPSec, SSL, DNS) and security architectures (SIEM, IDS/IPS).
 * Understanding of networking and system security best practices (WAN, routing, proxy).
 * Strong analytical thinking, structured working methods, and problem-solving abilities.
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.
 * High level of initiative, resilience under pressure, and organizational talent.
 * Business acumen and experience in budget and financial responsibility.
   
   

Bonus points if you have...


 * ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, or similar IT security certifications.

title: Security Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Purpose of Position
In this role, you will manage our SIEM, investigate security incidents, research and implement security tools, and participate in the Security Operations on-call rotation.
Core Responsibilities

 * SIEM Management & Optimization: Serve as the primary administrator for Microsoft Sentinel. This includes managing log ingestion from diverse sources (AWS, Azure, Defender for Endpoint, Akamai, etc.), optimizing data pipelines, and monitoring costs to ensure efficiency. Design and build comprehensive dashboards and workbooks to provide clear visibility into our security posture and key metrics for business and technical stakeholders.
 * Detection Engineering: Create, tune, and maintain security detection rules and alerts in Microsoft Sentinel, focusing on use cases relevant to our core business functions. Develop and refine detections based on threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK framework coverage analysis, with a keen focus on identifying gaps in our current logging and alerting.
 * Incident Investigation & Response: Lead in-depth technical investigations for security incidents, from triage to resolution. Analyze and correlate security events from across our hybrid cloud environment, leveraging logs and signals from AWS GuardDuty, Azure Monitor, Defender for Endpoint, and our CSPM. Provide actionable remediation plans and contribute to post-incident reviews to strengthen our defences.
 * Tooling & Automation: Research, evaluate, and implement new security technologies across the entire organization, from endpoints to cloud infrastructure, leading project planning and implementation.
 * On-Call & Response: Participate in the SecOps on-call rotation to provide rapid security incident response support.
 * Security Control Efficacy Testing: Run simulated attacks (e.g., using open-source tools or dedicated platforms) to test the effectiveness of existing security controls and detections.
   

Professional Experience And Skills

 * 3+ years in Incident Response, Detection Engineering or Threat Hunting
 * Participation in a formal incident response program, including on-call rotations and post-incident analysis.
 * Experience collaborating with engineering teams to implement security-by-design principles and resolve security findings.
 * Ability to deconstruct complex security incidents, correlate data from disparate sources, and identify root causes.
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively articulate technical risks to non-technical stakeholders (e.g., GRC, Legal, Finance) and coordinate with engineering teams during incidents.
 * Formal security certifications such as CISSP, CySA+, GIAC and AWS Security certifications are appreciated
 * Strong hands-on experience with SIEM platforms, specifically with Microsoft Sentinel or a similar enterprise-grade solution.
 * Demonstrated experience in security incident response within AWS and Azure cloud environments.
 * Proficiency in query languages like KQL, and scripting languages like PowerShell or Python for data analysis and automation. Experience utilizing APIs for custom tooling is preferred.
 * Experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
   

Our Offer

 * Flexi-Week and Work-Life Balance: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing, offering you a flexible four-day Flexi-Week at full pay and with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance. We also offer a variety of different paid special leaves.

 * Health & Well Being: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can devote yourself to your mental and physical well-being. .
 * Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite Awin Academy to cover a wide range of skills that nurture you professionally and personally, with trainings conveniently packaged together to support your overall development.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. title: 2026 Grad Program, Cyber Security
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.

This is an exclusive opportunity for top students on track to graduate between December 2025 and December 2026 to learn, make an impact, and accelerate their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
 * Run security audits, identifying security loopholes and opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of security strategies.
 * Perform internal vulnerability testing, uncovering any weaknesses in the systems and implementing countermeasures to ensure the integrity of all data.
 * Identify company-wide security challenges. Design and implement solutions to strengthen protection and streamline security practices across IT and infrastructure areas.
 * Collaborate closely with privacy experts to ensure the most robust and complete privacy compliance strategy possible, and to translate regulations into tech implementations.
 * Stay up to date with security trends and threats. Share knowledge with Spooners to ensure data protection best practices and help foster a security-focused culture across the company.
   
   

What we look for
 * Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
 * Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
 * Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
 * Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
   
   

What we offer
 * Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
 * An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
 * Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer an individual at the start of their career a salary of £66,779 in the UK and €63,965 elsewhere. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £110,389 and £149,636 in the UK, and €105,737 and €143,330 elsewhere. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience and translate it into greater impact. You can also receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
 * All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
   
   

Commitment & contract
Fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK) or remote.

The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll ask you to take on a few tests designed to assess how you approach unfamiliar problems. They’re challenging and may take several hours to complete. If you’re successful with those, we’ll invite you to a series of interviews.

We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment any applicant and provide reasonable accommodations for an individual with disabilities—just let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior IT Consultant Cyber Security
description:
Who We Are

Do you want to turn the challenges of digitalization into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core IT issues of leading global companies. Deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization. Add your individual strengths to our unique team, always there to support you. Together with Boston Consulting Group and our clients, we turn digital visions into reality.

What You'll Do


 * Cybersecurity Leadership and Strategy: Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cybersecurity roadmaps and strategic initiatives, aligning them with client objectives and digital transformation goals. Drive end-to-end security solutions from conceptual design to implementation, ensuring robust security architectures and frameworks are in place.
 * Client Engagement and Project Management: Manage and oversee complex cybersecurity projects, ensuring excellence in delivery while maintaining stringent timelines and budgets. Provide expert security advisory and support to clients throughout major IT transformation programs, helping them achieve and maintain key security certifications such as ISO27001.
 * Innovative Solution Development: Utilize advanced technologies like AI, blockchain, and cloud computing to design and refine innovative cybersecurity solutions. Tailor strategies to include aspects of identity & access governance, data protection, security monitoring, and network protection.
 * Team Leadership and Development: Cultivate a supportive and inclusive team environment, promoting continuous learning and professional growth. Mentor team members, oversee the recruitment of top-tier talent, and foster a culture of excellence and innovation.
 * Vendor and Stakeholder Management: Effectively select and manage relationships with security vendors, services, and solution providers to enhance the security offerings provided to clients.
   
   

What You'll Bring


 * A university degree in cyber security, information technology, or a related field.
 * From 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in IT security consulting or a similar role, demonstrating a track record of leading sizable and complex projects.
 * Strong practical knowledge of cybersecurity operating processes and frameworks such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27000, and SABSA.
 * Holders of professional certifications like CISSP, CISM, or ISO27001 are preferred.
 * Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to manage interdisciplinary teams and complex stakeholder relationships.
 * Excellent communication skills in both Italian and English are required
 * Comfortable working in global contexts and adaptable to rapidly changing environments.
 * Readiness to travel extensively as required by client engagements and project demands.
   
   

Who You'll Work With

How you can grow with us We guarantee constant new development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment. You'll face challenges every day together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues. Individual training offers and a culture of open feedback will provide the framework you need to explore and perfect your own strengths. Our modern structures enable you to stay focused. OT Senior Specialist – Cybersecurity Industriale
description:
Chi siamo

Netgroup è un’azienda italiana con oltre 30 anni di esperienza nell’Information & Communication Technology, con un forte focus sulla cybersecurity e sulle soluzioni tecnologiche avanzate per infrastrutture critiche. Supportiamo le aziende nel proteggere i loro sistemi digitali e industriali, integrando competenze IT e OT per garantire sicurezza, resilienza e continuità operativa in contesti complessi e regolamentati.




Chi ricerchiamo

Cerchiamo un OT Senior Specialist esperto, con consolidata esperienza in ambienti industriali e operativi, che sappia fare da ponte tra i team di cybersecurity e l’ingegneria di settore. La figura ideale possiede una profonda conoscenza dei sistemi di controllo industriale e dei processi produttivi, ed è capace di guidare l’analisi dei rischi e la progettazione di soluzioni cyber-resilienti su misura per i vincoli e le dinamiche degli ambienti OT.




Responsabilità principali

 * Integrare competenze pratiche e operative sui sistemi OT all’interno del team cybersecurity.
 * Collaborare con specialisti cyber per valutare l’impatto delle soluzioni di sicurezza sugli ambienti di produzione.
 * Supportare clienti durante assessment tecnici, survey e raccolta requisiti.
 * Analizzare architetture OT complesse, identificando criticità e opportunità di miglioramento.
 * Contribuire alla definizione di architetture sicure e compatibili con i vincoli industriali.
 * Realizzare documentazione tecnica, disegni architetturali e piani di intervento.
 * Formare i team interni sulle tecnologie, protocolli e dinamiche degli ambienti OT.




Requisiti richiesti

 * Esperienza minima di 8-10 anni in ambito industriale, automazione e impiantistica.
 * Ottima conoscenza di sistemi di controllo industriale (PLC, SCADA, DCS, RTU, HMI).
 * Familiarità con protocolli industriali (Modbus, OPC, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, IEC 60870, IEC 61850, ecc.).
 * Esperienza in settori quali energia, oil & gas, manifatturiero, farmaceutico o infrastrutture critiche.
 * Conoscenza delle architetture di rete OT e capacità di leggere schemi elettrici e P&ID.
 * Eccellenti capacità comunicative per interfacciarsi efficacemente con tecnici di campo e specialisti IT/cyber.
 * Disponibilità a trasferte presso siti industriali.




Titoli preferenziali:

 * Esperienza in progetti di convergenza IT/OT o cybersecurity in ambienti OT.
 * Conoscenza base delle normative IEC 62443, NIS2 o framework NIST.
 * Certificazioni in ambito automazione o controllo industriale (Siemens, ABB, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, ecc.).




Perché entrare in Netgroup

 * Opportunità di lavorare in progetti di punta per la cybersecurity industriale.
 * Ambiente dinamico, orientato all’innovazione e alla crescita professionale.
 * Collaborazione con team multidisciplinari e clienti di rilievo internazionale.
 * Formazione continua e accesso a tecnologie all’avanguardia.




Se vuoi mettere a frutto la tua esperienza nei sistemi OT e contribuire alla sicurezza delle infrastrutture critiche, inviaci il tuo CV!




Ti invitiamo, prima di presentare la candidatura, a leggere attentamente l’informativa Netgroup sul trattamento dei dati personali, conforme agli articoli 13 e 14 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679, disponibile al seguente link: https://www.netgroup.it/informativa-recruiting.pdf

 * Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
 * Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
   
   

What we offer
 * Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
 * An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
 * Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer an individual at the start of their career a salary of £66,779 in the UK and €63,965 elsewhere. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £110,389 and £149,636 in the UK, and €105,737 and €143,330 elsewhere. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience and translate it into greater impact. You can also receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
 * All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
   
   

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK) or remote.

The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll ask you to take on a few tests designed to assess how you approach unfamiliar problems. They’re challenging and may take several hours to complete. If you’re successful with those, we’ll invite you to a series of interviews.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment any applicant and provide reasonable accommodations for an individual with disabilities—just let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

title: Senior Security Specialist
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Kyndryl’s Security & Resiliency is one of our most critical practices, ensuring enterprises, regardless of their size and complexity, remain secure, available, reliable, and resilient. We take Cybersecurity seriously. We're not just invested; we're committed. We're not just protecting data; we're empowering. Kyndryl is committed to making the world safer, not only by investing in state-of-the-art services and technologies but also by empowering underserved communities with essential cyber skills.

When you walk through our doors, you're not only joining a team but you're also becoming part of a legacy. Welcome to Kyndryl, where Cybersecurity isn't just a job – it’s a passion; a commitment to designing, running, and managing the most modern and reliable technology infrastructure that the world depends on every day.

Are you ready to take on the cyber threats of tomorrow? As a Senior Security Specialist working alongside our Cybersecurity Architecture team, you'll be on the front line of protecting computer systems and networks from the ever-evolving landscape of hacking, viruses, and malicious attacks. Through the implementation, deployment, and maintenance of security solutions you’ll ensure the utmost confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. We're not looking for ordinary; we need individuals with deep expertise in specific technologies, a flair for automation, and a passion for developing innovative use cases.

This role isn’t just protecting data – it’s a vital operation for facilitating trust with our customers. With your technical expertise in cybersecurity and infrastructure, covering everything from networks and servers to systems and hardware devices, you'll lead the charge in deploying high-tech solutions that not only meet compliance with regulations and industry standards but also exceed expectations.

As a Senior Security Specialist you'll oversee incident response, vulnerability management, and cyber threat hunting. You'll execute security solutions applying cutting-edge technologies like firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, antivirus software, and vulnerability scanners. You will be instrumental in not only addressing threats but also proactively recommending system tuning, identifying new use cases, and providing additional insight from customer and industry data to continually enhance the value of our services.

If you're ready to take on a role where every line of code and every solution you implement could be the difference between security and vulnerability, then Kyndryl is the place for you. Your expertise is not just welcome here – it’s celebrated and valued. Join us as a Senior Security Specialist, and together we’ll fortify our cyber defenses making the world a safer place in the digital age.

Your Future at Kyndryl

When you join Kyndryl, you're not just joining a company – you're entering a space of opportunities. Our partnerships with industry alliances and vendors mean you'll have access to skilling and certification programs needed to excel in Security & Resiliency, while simultaneously supporting your personal growth. Whether you envision your career path as a technical leader within cybersecurity or transition into other technical, consulting, or go-to-market roles – we’re invested in your journey.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills And Experience


 * 5 years of experience in engineering/deploying security technologies e.g., EDR, MDR, SIEM, SOAR
 * Demonstrated experience with managing and maintaining current system security measures as well as implementing new systems
 * Experience with cloud security, cyber resiliency/incident management, Zero Trust, network/EDGE security, and emerging technologies such as IoT and AI
 * Expertise in network, host, and cloud-based security, attack techniques, analysis, and investigation
 * Deep understanding of the current cyber threat landscape, the different tactics commonly used by adversaries and how you would investigate, contain and recover against their attacks
   
   

Preferred Skills And Experience


 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or other related fields
 * Preferred Certifications in Cyber Security: ECTHP (Certified Threat Hunting Professional) or  ECMAP (Malware Analysis Professional)
 * Experience in security monitoring and in advanced analytics (UEBA)

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

description:
Who We Are

Do you want to turn the challenges of digitalization into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core IT issues of leading global companies. Deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization.  * Holders of professional certifications like CISSP, CISM, or ISO27001 are preferred.
 * Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to manage interdisciplinary teams and complex stakeholder relationships.
 * Excellent communication skills in both Italian and English are required
 * Comfortable working in global contexts and adaptable to rapidly changing environments.
 * Readiness to travel extensively as required by client engagements and project demands.
   
   

Who You'll Work With

We guarantee constant new development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment. You'll face challenges every day together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues. title: 2026 Grad Program, Cyber Security
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.

This is an exclusive opportunity for top students on track to graduate between December 2025 and December 2026 to learn, make an impact, and accelerate their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
 * Run security audits, identifying security loopholes and opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of security strategies.
 * Perform internal vulnerability testing, uncovering any weaknesses in the systems and implementing countermeasures to ensure the integrity of all data.
 * Identify company-wide security challenges. Design and implement solutions to strengthen protection and streamline security practices across IT and infrastructure areas.
 * Collaborate closely with privacy experts to ensure the most robust and complete privacy compliance strategy possible, and to translate regulations into tech implementations.
 * Stay up to date with security trends and threats. Share knowledge with Spooners to ensure data protection best practices and help foster a security-focused culture across the company.
   
   

What we look for
 * Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
 * Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
 * Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
 * Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.
   
   

What we offer
 * Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
 * An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
 * Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer an individual at the start of their career a salary of £66,779 in the UK and €63,965 elsewhere. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £110,389 and £149,636 in the UK, and €105,737 and €143,330 elsewhere. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience and translate it into greater impact. You can also receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
 * All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
   
   

Commitment & contract
Fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK) or remote.

The selection process
If you pass our screening, we’ll ask you to take on a few tests designed to assess how you approach unfamiliar problems. They’re challenging and may take several hours to complete. If you’re successful with those, we’ll invite you to a series of interviews.

We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment any applicant and provide reasonable accommodations for an individual with disabilities—just let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Cybersecurity Certifications Specialist
description:
You will play a key role as a Cybersecurity Specialist as part of our Global Cybersecurity Certification Program team.

How You'll Make An Impact


 * Assist Cybersecurity Certification Team Manager in End-to-End certification activities.
 * Assist and interact with the internal assessments team for NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, ISO 27001, TISAX, Fedramp, SOC 2 Type 2 and related activities.
 * Plan, design, manage, and carry out project plans to assure delivery and ensure project plans fulfill their objectives.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams / key stakeholders to comprehend procedures and promote results.
 * Participate in audits and site visits, as requested.
 * Identify ways to streamline and optimize processes.
 * Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure that external audits are carried out efficiently.
 * Ensure certification is maintained, contributing to the process related to yearly surveillance audits and re-certification audits by interacting with external auditors from a certification body and liaising internally with various stakeholders across the globe to ensure necessary readiness.
 * Ensure continual compliance and react to scope changes.
 * Live core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
   
   

Your Background


 * Bachelor’s degree (ideally in Engineering or Computer Science).
 * Minimum of 10 years' overall experience and at least 5 years in Information or Cybersecurity domain.
 * Interest in pursuing a career in the Cybersecurity Certifications domain.
 * Experienced GRC professional
 * Knowledge of NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, and ISO 27001, TISAX, Fedramp, SOC 2 Type 2 standards.
 * Team player with an ability and willingness to learn and grow within the organization.
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform within deadlines.
 * Additionally, knowledge of Cybersecurity standards and associated certifications specific to companies in Unites States.
 * Any relevant Cybersecurity-related certification will be an added value.
 * Fluency in English (both written and verbal) with excellent communication skills.
 * Ability to work globally, in an internationally spread-out organization, with diverse personalities and different cultures, along with the flexibility to sometimes work in different time zones and willingness to do occasional business travel.
   
   
   

More About Us

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

We can provide more information during the recruitment process.
